policy: Korean is canonical. Translations are display aids only. Never fabricate official English or Chinese names: a translation is shown only when its confidence is canonical/official/manual-derived/curated. Entries marked needs-verification or fallback are stored for review but render Korean. Visa/status codes (D-2, F-4, E-7, G-1, G-1-5, ...) are never translated.

integrated_application_form_34.en: Application Form (Report Form) — Annex Form No. 34
integrated_application_form_34.notes: English follows the bilingual heading printed on the official 별지 제34호 form (APPLICATION FORM (REPORT FORM)). Do not invent a Chinese official translation without a verified source.

family_relation_certificate.source: Act on Registration of Family Relations, Art. 15(1)1 (English translation via law.go.kr/KLRI, retrieved via Legal_Data_Hunter MCP)
family_relation_certificate.notes: Statute wording is lowercase 'family relation certificate'; Title-Cased here for document-name consistency with the rest of the glossary. Embassy/apostille sources (unverified) also use 'Certificate of Family Relations' — same meaning, different word order.

marriage_relation_certificate.source: Act on Registration of Family Relations, Art. 15(1)3 (via Legal_Data_Hunter MCP -> law.go.kr/KLRI)
marriage_relation_certificate.notes: Statute wording is lowercase 'Marriage relation certificate'; Title-Cased for consistency. Court-registry system (scourt.go.kr) may render 'Marriage Relations Certificate' per unverified search leads.

basic_certificate.source: Widely used in Korean administrative/embassy/apostille contexts
basic_certificate.notes: The underlying statute (Act on Registration of Family Relations Art. 15(1)2, verified via law.go.kr/KLRI this session) literally translates this document type as 'Identification certificate'. Chose the practically-used 'Basic Certificate' instead because it is what applicants actually encounter on Korean administrative/embassy checklists; flagging the statute's literal wording here for transparency rather than silently picking one.

resident_registration_copy.source: Enforcement Decree of the Resident Registration Act (e.g. Arts. 8, 47, 49 — 'certified copy ... of a resident registration record card'), via Legal_Data_Hunter MCP -> law.go.kr/KLRI
resident_registration_copy.notes: Compressed from the statute's fuller phrasing into a document-name form. Distinguish from 초본 (abstract/extract), which the same statute treats as a different document.

certificate_of_all_registered_matters.source: Commercial Registration Act, Art. 15 ('an application for perusal of all or part of matters recorded in a registered record and the issuance of a certificate of registered matters'), via Legal_Data_Hunter MCP -> law.go.kr/KLRI
certificate_of_all_registered_matters.notes: The exact compound 'Certificate of All Registered Matters' is a reasonable construction from adjacent statute language ('all ... matters' + 'certificate of registered matters'), not a verbatim quoted phrase — hence manual-derived rather than official.
